notes.title: Clutter VI soon available on Steam
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30216820/38ae25c37259bb302ff38337e052916987d73c15.jpg[/img]

With Leigh's Story, the Clutter series has risen to a whole new level. For the first time, there is a compelling story with gameplay to match. 
[list]
[*]Over 500 New Objects
[*]Lots of New Music
[*]Many New Variations of Clutter
[*]75+ Picture Puzzles, 75+ Box Quotes Puzzles
[*]As always, randomly generated levels give you hours and hours of replayability
[/list]

notes.title: A hidden object game with a delightful twist
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5827377/8b96361af158e0fb2755cc70b73d21cf7d2ccc01.jpg[/img]

This just might be the best Clutter of them all. So many varations, so little time. All your old favorites are here along with twice as many new ones to keep you playing for hour and hours. 875 puzzles in all. Intermixed, Silhouettes, Outside-In and Clutter Picture Puzzles just to name a few. 
[list]
[*]Lots of Newer, Cleaner Objects and All New Quest Music 
[*]Many New Variations of Clutter 
[*]New Favorites and Replay Features 
[*]75+ Picture Puzzles and 75+ Box Quotes Puzzles 
[*]Randomly generated levels provide hours and hours of replayability 
[/list]


http://store.steampowered.com/app/553330/Clutter_Infinity_Joes_Ultimate_Quest/
